scenes.title: One Coat Too Many
scenes.narration: Mara checked the empty train before the last lights went out. In carriage nine, a red raincoat hung over a seat. It looked exactly like hers, including the small repair on its sleeve. "My coat is in my locker. I left it there this morning." She lifted her yellow torch. Water was dripping from the coat onto a dry floor.

scenes.title: A Message Before the Step
scenes.narration: The ceiling speaker clicked. A calm voice said that Mara would step back from the wet seat. She had not moved yet. Then her foot slid backwards across the floor. "You will look at the door now. The door will stay open." Mara looked. The platform door was open, but the red coat was no longer dripping.

scenes.title: A Voice That Waits
scenes.narration: Her phone camera showed the empty seat. On its screen, the red coat was missing. Mara could photograph the carriage or leave her phone on the seat and walk out. She kept both feet still. "You will choose the picture. You always choose the picture." For the first time, the voice sounded uncertain. The open doorway was only a few steps away.
scenes.prompt: What was different on the phone screen?
scenes.explanation: Mara could see the coat directly, but her camera showed the seat without it.

scenes.title: Evidence on the Platform
scenes.narration: Mara took one picture and stepped onto the platform. The train lights went dark behind her. In the photograph, the coat was finally visible, folded neatly on the seat. Her own yellow torch lay beside it. "That cannot be right. I am still holding the torch." She showed the picture to the night manager and refused to return alone. The camera had recorded a scene she had never seen.

scenes.title: The Call from the Locker
scenes.narration: Mara left her phone on the seat and walked onto the platform. The speaker went silent. In the staff room, her own red raincoat was still inside her locker. Something vibrated in its pocket. "I left my phone on the train. This pocket should be empty." She closed the locker without reaching inside and called the night manager from the desk phone. Together, they waited for morning outside the room.

She returns to the train alone

scenes.explanation: Mara leaves the pocket untouched, closes the locker and calls from the desk phone.
